observed_bottleneck: Parent n-895bba5eb944 generates large valid novel pools and its acquisition ranks them consistently, but the only objective model is one radius-2 count-Morgan Tanimoto GP. Its posterior tilt is strongly representation- and task-dependent: the posterior-versus-prior PI lift is positive in only 3 of 29 zaleplon_mpo rounds with mean 1.1947511043448278e-07, selected-batch EI lift on that task is only 3.0909406350689663e-06, and terminal Top-1 remains 0.08458763933182971 on drd2_docking and 0.1694581623260221 on median_2. This is not a generation-capacity failure: all 145 rounds formed pools of at least 240 molecules, aggregate novel-valid decode yield was 0.9081992337164757, and every batch filled. Cross-lineage node n-d473bfe7172d further shows that exact Tanimoto predictors over complementary Morgan, RDKit-path, and atom-pair fingerprints can all fit the same sparse oracle histories and produce positive multi-fingerprint EI selection lift on all 145 rounds, including 0.00269491059855388 on zaleplon_mpo. The limiting Parent behavior is therefore committing both posterior tilting and acquisition to one fixed structural similarity view even when its predicted improvement collapses.
hypothesis: Replace only the Parent's single count-Morgan objective surrogate with a task-local likelihood-weighted model average of exact Tanimoto GPs over three fixed complementary molecular fingerprints: the inherited radius-2 count Morgan representation, an RDKit topological-path representation, and an atom-pair representation. Refit all usable models to the identical oracle-evaluated set each round, derive deterministic model weights from their exact leave-one-out predictive log densities under equal priors, and use the weighted posterior for both pCN probability-of-improvement tilting and greedy expected-improvement batch selection so objective evidence can choose which structural similarity view guides proposals.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic SELFIES variational autoencoder on the unlabeled corpus solely as a de novo molecular generator, while fitting the online objective surrogate only on oracle-evaluated molecules using count-based molecular fingerprints and a Tanimoto Gaussian process. At each feedback round, use preconditioned Crank-Nicolson sampling to draw new latent points from the VAE prior tilted by the GP posterior probability of exceeding the incumbent, decode them into previously unseen molecules, and greedily choose a high-utility batch of ten. Decoupling generation from structure-space prediction avoids requiring objective smoothness in the VAE latent geometry and directs the fixed 290 post-initial oracle calls toward molecules likely to improve the final Top-1 rather than screening or retrieving a finite corpus pool.
